item.title: AB Dynamics acquired US test systems firm eMpulse in $11m deal
item.summary: AB Dynamics has acquired eMpulse Test Systems, a US maker of advanced automotive test equipment, for an initial $11.0m (£8.1m) in cash. The deal is aimed at expanding its laboratory testing business, which has recently been hit by the conflict in the Middle East, seeing sales slow.
